heading: cySub-tenants and mortgage lenders
paragraphs: cyYou must give details of any sub-tenants or mortgage lenders connected to the property. The court will tell them about this claim.
cyIf your tenant has rented the property to someone else, that person is called an ‘underlessee’. If you have a mortgage on the property, your lender is called a ‘mortgagee’.
cyAn underlessee or mortgagee may be able to ask the court to cancel a possession order. This is called ‘relief from forfeiture’.
question: cyDo you need to give details of a sub-tenant or a mortgage lender?
